comparison.objective: Set and lock a gripper opening stop versus load two forceps open into a sterilizer basket.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires tool-mediated countertorque and later fixture actuation; forceps handling requires opening friction hinges, carrying articulated tools, and placing them flat without stacking.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate checks locked angular repeatability; forceps scoring checks both instruments released, flat, inside the basket, and at least 15° open.
comparison.reason: Articulated motion is common, but the tested abilities and end states are different.
